summary: The submission provides a Literature Corpus Scoping Report (Task 1) that extracts metadata, defines domain boundaries, and lists references for eight papers on classical scheduling methods in steel/metal production. It includes tables of titles, authors, journals, keywords, and brief abstract snippets, as well as notes on excluded papers and missing files.
issues: Only Task 1 (Inventory) is present; tasks 2‑5 are missing.
Several referenced papers were unavailable and could not be processed.
The submission does not include synthesis, integrative synthesis, or final report components required by the full assignment.
